questions.q: Why were the windows of the State House nailed shut during the summer of 1787?
How do we know what was said inside the Constitutional Convention?
options: It was read aloud in church
The king's spies wrote it down
James Madison wrote down every debate

questions.q: What was the great bargain between the big states and the small states?
options: A House counted by population and a Senate with two votes per state
Small states got their own president
Each state got one vote on everything

questions.q: How did the framers handle the word 'slavery' in the Constitution?
options: They wrote a whole chapter about it
They never wrote the word in the document at all

questions.q: What did Franklin finally say about the sun carved on Washington's chair?
What was about to happen at Newburgh in March 1783?
options: The unpaid army was being urged to march on Congress
The British were attacking the camp
The soldiers were sailing to France

questions.q: What did Washington do that made his hardened officers weep?
options: He read a letter from the king
He fumbled for his spectacles and spoke of growing gray and almost blind in his country's service

questions.q: What did Washington do in December 1783, after the war was won?
options: He resigned his command and went home to his farm
He took command of the navy

questions.q: What title did Washington settle on as the first president?
Why was the election of 1800 such a big moment for the world?
options: It was the first election ever held anywhere
Power passed peacefully between bitter rivals because the voters said so

questions.q: What did President Jefferson originally want to buy from France?
options: The port city of New Orleans

questions.q: What happened in Haiti that helped push Napoleon to sell Louisiana?
options: A gold rush emptied the island
Enslaved people rose up and defeated the armies sent against them

questions.q: What was the price of the Louisiana Purchase?
options: Fifteen million dollars, about three cents an acre

questions.q: What worried Jefferson about the deal?
options: The land was too swampy to farm
The Constitution said nothing about buying territory
He thought the price was too high for one city

questions.q: Who was never asked about the sale of the Louisiana Territory?
options: The Native nations who lived there

questions.q: What was the mission of the Corps of Discovery?
options: To explore the new territory all the way to the Pacific
To dig for gold in the mountains
To build forts along the Mississippi
To map the coast of Florida

questions.q: What did Sacagawea do when a boat capsized in the river?
options: She swam to shore for help
She calmly caught the instruments, medicines, and journals as they floated away
She repaired the boat with birch bark

questions.q: What astonishing thing happened when Sacagawea translated for the Shoshone chief Cameahwait?
options: He refused to speak with her
He demanded the expedition turn back
The chief turned out to be her brother

questions.q: What happened when the corps voted on where to spend the winter by the Pacific?
options: Everyone's voice was counted, including York's and Sacagawea's

questions.q: What did York ask for when the expedition returned, and what was the answer?
options: He asked for his freedom, and for years Clark said no
He asked for land and received a farm
He asked to lead the next expedition and did
He asked for gold and got it

questions.q: What did Dolley Madison refuse to leave behind in the White House?
options: The huge portrait of George Washington

questions.q: Why was the Fort McHenry flag sewn on the floor of a brewery?
options: It was hidden there from the British
No ordinary room was big enough for a flag thirty feet tall
The fort had no sewing rooms

questions.q: How long did the British bombardment of Fort McHenry last?
Where was Francis Scott Key during the battle?
options: On a truce ship, held until the attack ended

questions.q: What question did Key strain to answer at dawn?
options: Whether the British fleet had sunk
Whether his letter had been delivered
Which flag was flying over the fort
